Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever wondered if there’s something more to life than just chasing comfort, security, and personal success? We all crave meaning and purpose beneath the surface, even if we don’t always say it out loud.
As we dive into Radical: Taking Back Your Faith from the American Dream by David Platt, we’ll look at the subtle ways our faith can get tangled up with the world’s ideas of prosperity and self-fulfillment.
What happens when real spiritual commitment runs up against the pull of material abundance? It’s a question that shakes us at our core and asks us what it really means to follow a path that changes lives.
Together, we’ll explore what it looks like to live with conviction, generosity, and courage—even when it goes against the grain of what we’re told success should be. It’s about rethinking our priorities and daring to embrace a life that’s marked by sacrifice and compassion.
Through stories, honest reflections, and practical steps, we’ll uncover not just the cost, but also the deep joy of choosing a higher purpose. Imagine setting aside the usual comforts of the American Dream and discovering the freedom and fulfillment that come from living out a radical faith.
Let’s open the door to a new way of living—one where selfless love and unwavering commitment have the power to change the world, starting with us. Are you ready to take this journey together?
